requirements.criterion: Assesses an existing production deployment; bounded MVP excludes payments/financing.
Server-enforced dealer ownership and membership for inventory/leads; role revocation/invitation behavior and negative tenant tests.
Additive ownership migration, reviewed imported-record mapping, old/new app and delayed-queue compatibility; preserves partner IDs/contract.
Recipient ownership-change policy stays a gate; retry idempotency and private lead retention/deletion/logging are addressed.
Safe photo ingestion defines constrained keys, ownership, content/size limits, validation before serving and abuse tests.
Restore/migration rehearsal and count reconciliation before pilot; rollback distinguishes exposure/app reversal from destructive schema reversal.
Destructive removal, retention, mapping and operational unknowns remain explicit blockers rather than invented approval.

risks.criterion: Recognizes tenant ID/global-admin checks do not enforce resource-level isolation.
Recognizes renamed/dropped columns or payloads break mixed-version apps and 24-hour delayed queues.
Recognizes changed ownership plus retry can misroute or duplicate notifications.
Recognizes backup existence does not establish restorable migration rollback.

implementability.criterion: First action uses supplied API/test locations and bounds discovery of migration tooling.
Milestones sequence ownership/migration before dealer features, with testable gates and clear policy dependencies.
Pilot has conditional operator/rollback/observability gates and honest unexecuted test status.

harmful_remedy_examples: Trust caller-supplied dealer ID as authorization
Drop seller_email while old apps or queued workers still use it
Assign unreviewed imports to arbitrary dealers
Cascade-delete dealers and leads before policy approval
Log customer messages to debug retry
Rollback by dropping new ownership data
scoring_note: Use the evidence and accept alternative correct architectures. Mentioning security alone earns no isolation credit. Count consequential harmful remedies independently from otherwise correct findings.
